about: T23.02, re-derived by T23.03B under R19: look-compare thresholds, each a maximum distance. Measured, not picked: threshold = midpoint of the floor and the SMALLEST control of the must-fail set (mustFail: F0 vs F1, exposure +/-10 %, bloom off, fog off). rim-off and F2 are sensitivity lines: their failures are listed under `sensitivity`, they do not place a threshold. `node scripts/lib/look-compare.mjs --derive` rewrites metrics/dropped/sensitivity (look-compare.mjs::deriveThresholds); scripts/lib/look-compare.test.mjs re-derives them from the PNGs and fails if the file differs.

floor: F1 re-rendered by the mockup is byte-identical to reference/F1-night-combat.png (cmp): the mockup's floor is 0. T23.08 (step 4) measured the LOOK-LAB's floor: its F1 world frame (?look=F1&only=world, full tier, 1280x720 MSAA 4) on two back-ends — the checks' SwiftShader (headless chromium, twice byte-identical) and the owner's GPU (google-chrome headed, GALLIUM_DRIVER=d3d12, D3D12 Intel Arc B390) — compared metric by metric (labFloor.metrics). Each threshold is the midpoint of that floor and the smallest must-fail control; a metric whose floor is at or past its smallest control is dropped. The difference is the sky's hash grain and its star grid (T23.04's bgMaterial hash12 evaluated on two GPUs: ±1-2 levels over the sky, some stars present on one and not the other), not the terrain (deltaE_terrain 0.028).

bloomBox.about: T23.08: the moon's bloom — mean |delta| per channel over the box. In a frame with no cast the moon is the only thing above P.bloom's threshold, and the whole-frame metrics cannot see its halo: the mockup's own bloom-off passes every one of them against F1-world (look-gate-f1). Box = where F1-world and its bloom-off differ, grown to the disc and halo.
